services.name: Kelly's Ford to Motts Run
services.desc: The Ultimate River Experience, this canoe or kayak adventure is perfect for the paddler looking for overnight river excursion with camping, paddling and lots of time to bond with friends and family. The rapids range from class I-II whitewater. Camping is not marked, however easy to locate from the riverbank. Duration 2-3 Days (24-48 Hours). A regular one-day paddle usually spans 12-14 hours. What's Included Shuttle to the put in location, Boat of choice with paddle and Lifejacket. services.name: Hole in the Wall to Motts Run
services.desc: Class I-II Rapids This is our Introduction to rapids experience. Families and friends of all ages are invited to test their skills at navigating the river, balancing canoes or kayaks through the mild rapids and communication. There is still plenty of time to fish and swim in the river. We encourage you to take your time on this adventure and to enjoy the journey down the historic Rappahannock river. Duration 6 Miles / 3-5 Hours. What's Included Shuttle to the put in location, Boat of choice with paddle and Lifejacket. What to Bring Please bring water, food, sunblock, and a good attitude. services.name: Whitewater Tube Trip
services.desc: The Best Day on the River - Book Now! This excursion takes an estimated 45 minutes to an hour and a half (sometimes 2 hours), depending on water levels. We reserve this section of the river for our tube rental only for the safety and protection of our guests. This is an experience for all ages above 6. However, this section of the river is not for the faint of heart, it will take you through rapids that will get your heart racing and your blood pumping. It's a great trip for family bonding or just a group of friends wanting to get on the river. Show up anytime from 10 am to 3:00 pm. The last time that we put tubes on the river is at 3:00 pm. services.name: City Dock  Rentals
services.desc: Rent a boat at the City Dock! We have Kayaks, Canoes and Stand-Up Paddle Boards for rent by the hour. This flat-water section of the river is perfect for the beginner looking to learn or for the more experienced looking to better their skills or just get out on the river for fun. We offer a short lesson for free upon request. We ask that all rentals paddle up stream where you will find lots to explore and areas where you are able to get out and swim. We will custom fit you to a boat of your choice and lifejacket for a great time on the river. Duration 2-6 Hour
